title: Hessdalen Glow Mystery

scenes.text: More than 8,000 reports of glowing orbs in Norway’s Hessdalen Valley
scenes.query: Norwegian valley night sky with luminous orbs

scenes.text: A 1998 study measured the orbs emitting up to 10 kW of power
scenes.query: scientists with equipment measuring bright light source
scenes.query2: research lab night with glowing sphere

scenes.text: The lights sometimes hover, then accelerate to 100 m/s before vanishing
scenes.query: animation of light orb accelerating over valley
scenes.query2: fast moving luminous sphere over forest

scenes.text: Current consensus points to ionized dust particles ignited by piezoelectric rocks, though the exact trigger remains unknown
scenes.query: rock formation with electric discharge illustration
scenes.query2: ionized dust particles glowing in night

scenes.query: night sky with subtle glowing particles

description: Hessdalen’s eerie lights have sparked decades of research. Learn what scientists think creates them and why the mystery persists.
